searchText: Is anyone against merging the following PR? Seems to be supported by everyone. https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4745 Can merge today if there's consensus. I am good with it Good with me I'm happy with it as I pointed in the review. Francesco is our of office but I assume he won't oppose it. If you want to feel better you can wait until the next breakout This is sufficient! Will merge in a bit. Thanks all. Regarding block proposer constructing payload attestation https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/master/specs/gloas/validator.md#constructing-payload_attestations > The slot of the parent block is exactly one slot before the proposing slot. Does this mean if proposer at slot n is not building on n - 1 block (could be n - 1 slot has no beacon block), proposer should include 0 payload attestation in its block body right? Yes. It's useless to include payload attestations for previous blocks and they aren't penalized/rewarded anyway

> The slot of the parent block is exactly one slot before the proposing slot.
Does this mean if proposer at slot n is not building on n - 1 block (could be n - 1 slot has no beacon block), proposer should include 0 payload attestation in its block body right?
